content:
# Testament of Dan — 7
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Cantabrigiensis) | **Section:** Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs

---

1:1 The-copy-of-the-words-of-Dan, which-he-spoke-to-his-sons in-his-last-days, in-the-hundred-and-twenty-fifth-year-of-his-life.
1:2 For-he-called-together-his-family, and-said: Hear-my-words, ye-sons-of-Dan; and-give-heed-to-the-words-of-your-father.
1:3 I-have-proved-in-my-heart and-in-my-whole-life that-truth-with-just-dealing-is-good-and-well-pleasing-to-God, and-that-lying-and-anger-are-evil, because-they-taught-me-concerning-them the-spirit-of-lies, that-it-might-lie; and-anger-unto-blood, that-I-might-be-troubled.
1:4 And-I-confess-now-my-sin: I-wished-to-kill-Joseph; for-the-spirit-of-jealousy-and-vainglory-said-to-me: Thou-also-art-his-son.
1:5 And-one-of-the-spirits-of-Beliar-stirred-me-up, saying: Take-this-sword, and-with-it-slay-Joseph; so-shall-thy-father-love-thee-when-he-is-dead.
1:6 Now-the-spirit-of-anger-sought-to-persuade-me-to-crush-Joseph-as-a-leopard-crushes-a-kid.
1:7 But-the-God-of-my-fathers did-not-suffer-him-to-fall-into-my-hands, so-that-I-found-him-not-alone; and-he-suffered-me-not-to-work-iniquity-with-my-hands, so-that-the-shame-of-Israel-might-not-be-increased.

2:1 And-now, my-children, behold-I-am-dying, and-I-tell-you-in-truth: unless-ye-keep-yourselves-from-the-spirit-of-lying-and-of-anger, and-love-truth-and-long-suffering, ye-shall-perish.
2:2 For-anger-is-blindness, and-suffereth-not-one-to-see-the-face-of-any-man-with-truth.
2:3 For-though-it-be-a-father-or-a-mother, he-behaveth-towards-them-as-enemies; though-it-be-a-brother, he-knoweth-him-not; though-it-be-a-prophet-of-the-LORD, he-disobeyeth-him; though-it-be-a-righteous-man, he-regardeth-him-not; though-it-be-a-friend, he-doth-not-acknowledge-him.
2:4 For-the-spirit-of-anger-encompasseth-him-with-the-net-of-deceit, and-blindeth-his-natural-eyes, and-through-lying-darkeneth-his-mind, and-giveth-him-its-own-peculiar-vision.
2:5 And-wherewith-doth-it-encompass-his-eyes? With-hatred-of-heart, so-as-to-be-jealous-of-his-brother.

3:1 For-anger-is-an-evil-thing, my-children, for-it-troubleth-even-the-soul-itself.
3:2 And-the-body-of-the-angry-man-it-maketh-its-own, and-over-his-soul-it-getteth-the-mastery, and-it-bestoweth-upon-the-body-power-that-it-may-work-all-iniquity.
3:3 And-when-the-body-doeth-all-these-things, the-soul-justifieth-what-is-done, since-it-seeth-not-aright.
3:4 Therefore-he-that-is-wrathful, if-he-be-a-mighty-man, hath-a-threefold-power-in-his-anger: one-by-the-help-of-his-servants, and-a-second-by-his-wealth whereby-he-persuadeth-and-overcometh-wrongfully, and-thirdly-having-his-own-natural-power.
3:5 And-though-the-wrathful-man-be-weak, yet-hath-he-a-power-twofold-of-that-which-is-by-nature; for-wrath-ever-aideth-such-in-lawlessness.
3:6 This-spirit-goeth-always-with-lying-at-the-right-hand-of-Satan, that-with-cruelty-and-lying-his-works-may-be-wrought.

4:1 Understand-therefore-the-power-of-wrath, that-it-is-vain; for-it-first-of-all-giveth-provocation-by-word; then-by-deeds-it-strengtheneth-him-who-is-angry, and-with-sharp-losses-disturbeth-his-mind, and-so-with-great-wrath-it-stirreth-up-his-soul-unto-destruction.
4:2 When-therefore-anyone-speaketh-against-you, be-not-ye-moved-to-anger, and-if-any-man-praiseth-you-as-holy-men, be-not-uplifted: be-not-moved-either-to-delight-or-to-distress.
4:3 For-first-it-pleaseth-the-hearing, and-so-sharpeneth-the-mind, and-then-being-enraged-he-thinketh-that-he-is-justly-angered.
4:4 If-ye-fall-into-any-loss-or-ruin, my-children, be-not-afflicted; for-this-very-spirit-maketh-a-man-desire-that-which-is-perishable, in-order-that-he-may-be-enraged-through-the-affliction.
4:5 For-if-ye-bring-against-him-losses-or-destruction-of-that-in-which-he-delights, he-is-maddened, and-from-the-madness-he-begets-hatred, and-from-the-hatred-he-proceeds-to-enmity, from-enmity-to-murder-and-murder-to-death.

5:1 Therefore-flee-the-evil-imagination-also, by-seeing-beforehand-the-temptation-of-Beliar; flee-from-all-lying, and-love-truth.
5:2 Keep-ye-therefore-the-commandments-of-the-LORD, and-cleave-to-his-law; and-depart-from-all-anger, and-love-truth-and-long-suffering.
5:3 And-the-things-ye-have-heard-from-your-father, tell-also-to-your-children, that-the-Saviour-of-the-nations-may-receive-you; for-he-is-true-and-long-suffering, meek-and-humble, and-teacheth-by-his-works-the-law-of-God.
5:4 Depart-therefore-from-all-unrighteousness, and-cleave-to-the-righteousness-of-God; and-your-race-shall-be-saved-for-ever, and-our-father-shall-rejoice-over-you.

6:1 And-behold-I-have-told-you-all-things, that-I-might-be-acquitted-of-your-sin.
6:2 For-if-ye-depart-from-the-evil, and-cleave-to-the-good, then-shall-the-LORD-dwell-among-you; because-he-loved-Jacob-our-father-and-all-his-seed.
6:3 But-I-know-that-the-works-of-Beliar-are-seven-against-mankind, and-they-are-the-heads-of-the-works-of-youth.
6:4 And-they-make-their-abode-with-man; and-in-their-last-end-they-shall-be-cast-down-before-him-who-is-first-among-them.
6:5 For-these-are-the-works-of-truth; and-the-works-of-Beliar-are-seven-against-mankind, and-they-are-the-heads-of-the-works-of-youth.

7:1 And-I-saw-that-the-rule-of-the-enemy-was-over-my-tribe.
7:2 And-there-shall-be-among-you-lying-and-strife, and-there-shall-be-no-truth, but-blunting-and-destruction, and-idolatry; for-the-Lord-shall-depart-from-you, and-the-spirit-of-Beliar-shall-be-with-you.
7:3 But-when-ye-turn-to-the-LORD-with-all-your-heart, being-humble-and-meek, then-shall-the-LORD-come-to-you-working-salvation-to-all-the-Gentiles.
7:4 And-he-shall-make-war-against-Beliar, and-he-shall-execute-an-everlasting-vengeance-on-our-enemies; and-the-captivity-shall-he-take-from-Beliar, even-the-souls-of-the-saints, and-shall-turn-disobedient-hearts-unto-the-LORD, and-shall-give-to-them-that-call-upon-him-eternal-peace.

---
*End of Testament of Dan*
